description: What the suite of the MCP server's tool profiles must notice (docs/MCP-SERVER.md "Tool profiles", P6 ext-19): the table and its own refusals (lib/mcp/tool-profiles.mjs), the scope names (lib/mcp/server-scope.mjs), the provider's scope checks and receipts, the token's scope (lib/mcp/server-token.mjs), the scope reaching the SDK and its 403 insufficient_scope (lib/mcp/server.mjs), the host's checks before the gate and after the owner's answer (lib/mcp/host.mjs), the check receipt (lib/verification-receipt.mjs) and the Hub's wiring (hub.mjs).
